history.summary: Dev Kit 0.16.1 — Select Mode (v0.8 F55, F56, F58): a Select tab; click a thing in the game or a UI kit part (button, switch, tab, slider, menu card…) → its tuning, text, sounds and shared UI style values in one place; select.json checked by checkSelectMap + unlistedSettings (every setting on some object); the panel tucks to a bar while selecting on a desktop; the Color tab also edits corners, outline, shadows, press feel, timings, menu sizes — proven by Glyphtender v0.11.0

UI kit 0.10.4 — tutorial parts (Callout with a pointer, tips memory + Tips switch, useNudge idle/wrong-action timer, MainMenu locked items, HowToPlay onSkip) and the menu frame (one menu width, cards open centred then grow down, ScrollArea with no scroll bar + a 'more' fade, MenuHeader ‹ · title · action, Settings section headings + confirm rows + ≤3 tabs as a bar, Selector as wide as its longest option) + Dev Kit 0.13.0 (Text tab: edit every string, search, placeholder guard) — proven by Glyphtender v0.10.0

Drag carry styles (ui-kit 0.6.1: presets A–D, carrier with lift / landings / returns / travel for AI pieces; target feedback: ghost preview, aim line, insertion marker, make room, magnetic snap) · Dev Kit 0.10.0 dropdowns (_choices) · table 0.7.1 (who played each move, swapInRack) · rooms 0.5.0 (server records who played) — proven by Glyphtender v0.7.0

Audio module (audio/ 0.2.1 — named sounds from content/audio.json, variation, limits, pitch ladder, streamed music with layers + rests, stacked mixes, phone rules) + Dev Kit 0.9.1 (Sound tab, Moments with Soft · Balanced · Punchy presets, search per tab) + UI kit 0.4.4 (Audio tab standard with a Sound switch, control sounds, menus that open centred and grow down) + the AI module (ai/ 0.1.0) and rooms 0.4.1 (idle takeover) — proven in Glyphtender v0.5.0–v0.6.0. v0.6 Audio ✅ (F31 audio check script = should, open); v0.5 AI still open (F22 banter, F24 arena)

The Table (table/ 0.6.0): game core + rules contract, events + per-seat feed, turns & flow, zones & pieces with stable ids, drag referee, rack order, seats + bots that see only their view; ui-kit 0.3.0 HandView (rack); rooms 0.2.0 per-seat events — proven by rebuilding Glyphtender v0.6 with no visible change
UI kit 0.2.15: player cards breathe (nothing touches an edge), carousels loop past the end, no orphan words, PlayerChip floatUps, count-up never dips below its start (from Glyphtender's v0.3.0 round)
Dev Kit becomes a framework module (one-command install, game tabs); UI kit 0.2.2 closes Roll Better's gaps
Game UI kit: 5 styles, ~36 ready screens, a passive game-ui skill, proven on Roll Better's settings
Project created — first module: game UI kit
Rooms module (online rooms, harvested from Roll Better); UI kit 0.2.10 (Carousel, ScreenStack, spacing); Dev Kit 0.5.0 (Screen previews, search, sections) — first used by Glyphtender v0.3.0

UI kit 0.7.0 — cards fit short screens (scroll inside themselves; Pause, Play online and lobby go two-column when short and wide; Settings tabs become a picker), every screen over the base layer dims it; Dev Kit mounts on idle in release builds (proven by Glyphtender v0.8.0)
UI kit 0.8.0: Pause takes extra rows (items). Dev Kit 0.12.3: the review list tab (Open / Yes / No, a game's own extra marks in one cycling box, search, reload after Save) — Glyphtender's Words tab
Framework checks for every game: overlap, cut-off and faint text, breathing room, fixed-size cards, comfort settings
Saves module: saved games survive updates, broken writes and browsers that wipe data
Patch notes and a licence check for every release; Credits shows open-source licences
Saves that resume, rejoin, copy by link code and check leaderboards; one version label in every game; portrait-only said once
Every sound in a game can come out equally loud and on time (audio check + levelled Sound Board drops)
Crash reports from players
The AI milestone: emotes, banter + Bot chatter, the personality check, shop-screen kit pieces
What wins? report + auto-tuner — every v0.5 AI feature done
Games take the AI: tappable seat rows, modules bring their own Settings switches
Story bubbles + clean installs: a talking bubble, report rows revealed one at a time, installs that keep a game's checks green
Games feed the framework: the extraction queue
Story pieces made solid: reveal replays, every bubble line heard, the Log trims itself
Checks you can trust: busy ports named, a clean gallery, bubble colours, installed fonts
